purpose: Preview-only battle HUD concepts; no Unreal assets or game behavior changed

interactionDesign.selection: One selected member; switch the right panel's contents without hiding any of the six cards.
interactionDesign.health: ECG plus text status; not a health bar.
interactionDesign.quickSlots: Four items belonging to selected member.
interactionDesign.interaction: Enter target-picking cursor mode, right-click or Escape cancels.
interactionDesign.squadMode: Replace individual member cards with squad summaries and group orders.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity game HUD concept board for the existing Chinese tactical game SILVER CHOIR. This is a design preview, not a real engine screenshot.
OUTPUT COMPOSITION: one large landscape design board, ideally 2560x1920, with a narrow title at top, one COMPLETE 16:9 gameplay screen occupying the upper three quarters, then a clearly separated full-width comparison strip showing ONLY the alternative squad-control bottom HUD. Do not put two full game screens side by side. Clean presentation, legible crisp simplified Chinese typography, carefully aligned UI. No mockup perspective, all interface surfaces front-facing.
Project style: deep blue-black panels, subdued steel-blue thin borders, restrained bright cyan selection accents, off-white Chinese sans-serif headings, tiny restrained English secondary labels, realistic near-future military personnel. Rectangular practical UI, subtle translucency, no fantasy ornament, no exaggerated neon bloom.
GAMEPLAY BACKGROUND: muted realistic isometric 3D tactical view of a weathered industrial checkpoint, roads, concrete barriers, crates and low buildings with six small tactical operators; a large clear central play area. No gore. HUD should be the focal point and have much higher clarity than the subdued background.
UPPER RIGHT: a compact tablet-like minimap, landscape map display with streets, cyan friendly markers and selected squad direction, tiny north marker and T5 location label; narrow controls for centering/follow, map layers, plus, minus and collapse. Keep the frame compact. Small status/time indicators integrated, no huge top bar.
CRITICAL MEMBER MODE: bottom HUD must contain EXACTLY SIX complete member cards simultaneously PLUS ONE separate expanded action panel to their RIGHT. Never omit the sixth card, never cover a member with the drawer, no scrolling to see the six. A very narrow squad selector rail at extreme left with squad insignias 01 / 02 / 03. Extreme right is a narrow vertical mode rail with icon buttons labeled “成员” and “小队”, “成员” selected. The single expanded panel belongs to selected member “寒锋”.
Logical 1920px layout reference: outer margins 24 each; squad rail 72; main member area 1312; open action panel 404; mode rail 48; three main gaps 12. Fit everything inside this width. Respect these relative proportions rather than printing these dimensions.
Six distinct adult operators named left-to-right “白露”, “磐石”, “寒锋”, “夜莺”, “银针”, “脉冲”. Portraits are SQUARE crops with complete faces and a little shoulders, not long full-body portraits. Each card has: name; portrait; visible HEALTH ECG waveform with small “稳定” / “负伤” text (NO health bar); TWO thin separate status bars labeled “体力” and “士气”; exactly TWO small equipment slots labeled “左手” / “右手”, with recognizable rifle/pistol/empty equipment silhouettes. Use cyan/amber ECG states. Distinguish selected card with cyan outline; third member selected.
ACTION DRAWER: title “寒锋 / 个体指令”; first row three posture buttons with clear human silhouette icons and labels “站立”, “蹲伏”, “匍匐”, crouch selected. Next row(s) with crisp icons and short labels: “背包”, “潜行”, “交互”, “拾取 / 拖拽”; show stealth as a toggle. Tiny helper “交互：选择目标 · 右键取消”. At the VERY BOTTOM of the action panel exactly FOUR equally sized quick-item slots labeled 1 2 3 4, holding medkit, grenade, smoke grenade and radio/tool icons. The action panel has sufficient space for all controls and a subtle slide-open edge, not a pop-up in world center.
LOWER COMPARISON STRIP: label “小队控制 · 底栏切换示意”. Replace the six personnel cards with a row of THREE large SQUAD SUMMARY cards: “第一小队” 6/6, “第二小队” 4/6, “第三小队” 5/6, with distinct squad insignias, compact member status dots, status text, stamina/morale summaries. NO individual portrait cards in this mode. The matching right action area shows selected squad name and whole-squad orders with icons “移动”, “停止”, “集结”, “警戒”, “潜行”, plus a compact formation selector. Rightmost mode rail now highlights “小队”. It is a replacement layout, not a second HUD simultaneously in game.
Avoid: extra member cards, fewer than six member cards, duplicated UI labels, text wall, health bars, cropped HUD, horizontal scrolling, giant bezels, fantasy art, anime portraits, neon clutter, rounded mobile-app cards.

VARIANT A — title exact “A  战术终端” with small subtitle “单排六人 · 固定指令区”.
Design the most immediately shippable, refined tactical terminal matching the current project. Flat dark navy surfaces, one-pixel cyan/steel dividing rules, very restrained visual texture, excellent visual hierarchy. Main gameplay bottom dock about 275px high at logical1080px. SIX MEMBER CARDS IN ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal widths, each a clean vertical rectangular card about212px wide. In each card name at top, square portrait on upper left and compact ECG plot on upper right; stamina and morale bars below; two wide hand slots across bottom. Action panel to their right matches height. Important: six separate visible portrait cards followed by the action panel, not five. Minimap is a sleek dark navy Pad with slim bezel, cyan selection and clear cartography. All icon silhouettes should be practical and legible. Show subdued industrial yard in cool daylight, selected operator and a small interaction cursor near a crate. Lower squad strip uses matching flat terminal surfaces. Elegant professional PC tactical game screenshot quality.

VARIANT B — title exact “B  野战平板” with small subtitle “装备感 · 大头像 · 分区按键”.
This design must be visually and structurally distinct from a flat HUD: a believable rugged field-tablet equipment interface, graphite/navy slate body, recessed screens, small physical-looking separators, restrained corner fasteners, softly beveled mechanical buttons, subtle amber caution details, cyan selection. Still elegant and readable, no huge fake plastic bezel. The miniMAP looks like a real compact tactical Pad anchored upper-right, thumb-sized controls in a narrow lower hardware strip.
Bottom dock about310px tall at logical1080px; SIX equal portrait-first member cards IN ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, each full square portrait occupying the upper center (~105px), name caption plus status ECG just below, then compact stamina/morale rails, then two hand equipment slots at bottom. Each card is a recessed modular display. Exactly six visible full cards; third selected. To their right one generous matching recessed action console containing all posture/action buttons and 4 quick slots, no overlap. Buttons more tactile with large silhouette icons. Tiny amber “负伤” indicator on one member while others cyan stable ECG. A strong industrial yet contemporary hierarchy, not a retro green military screen. Desaturated concrete depot background in warm overcast dusk. Lower squad comparison retains the same recessed module construction and hardware buttons. Use project-compatible dark navy, offwhite text, restrained cyan selection, amber only secondary.
